historical_corrections.interpretation: Original fixture failures and terminal cancelled attempt1 are preserved with their source, step and artifact-availability facts. Effective success records retain distinct API and original execution identities.

limitations: This accepts the frozen pull-request run and its exact tree; it does not infer successful post-merge CI from tree equality or carried-forward API records.

GitHub retry records may receive new IDs while retaining original execution times, steps and logs. API-record and execution provenance are recorded separately; carried successes are not claimed as re-executed tests.
Canceled/failed earlier runs and attempts retain their actual conclusions and diagnostics. They are not relabeled successful or substituted for missing effective gates.
Only the explicitly listed downloaded artifacts received archive/report/PNG review. Metadata-only artifacts are identified; all-PNG decoding is distinct from representative visual review.
Scoped checksum/checkout/runtime/diagnostic log receipts are retained; raw job logs, signed download URLs and authentication state are not embedded.
Synthetic fixtures and isolated services do not establish customer-host installation, upgrade, rollback, protected origin/CDN configuration or approved live-provider acceptance.

Payments remain Sandbox-only. Authoritative recurring lifecycle, immutable membership/bundle terms and selected merchant integration remain separate engineering; live mail/age and owner policy/retention acceptance remain external.
